title: Resolution to set property tax class shares for Fiscal 2027
summary: This resolution updates and finalizes the share of the citywide property tax levy paid by each of the four property classes for Fiscal 2027, reflecting property construction, demolition and reclassification since the June 30, 2026 certification. It is required under state law following a May 2026 amendment that let the City adjust its calculation method. The updated shares show increases for Class 3 and 4 properties and decreases for Class 1 and 2 properties compared to the earlier Fiscal 2027 figures.
